Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers need to know the entry rules before arriving at Aurelia Skyways with an animal.

Aurelia Skyways asks travelers to check age, crate, and comfort rules before booking space for a pet. Safety takes priority over speed on every journey, so the Companion Animal Travel Desk reviews each case with care and keeps instructions clear for the day of travel. Bring the animal, the crate, and any papers requested at check-in, and make sure the carrier is secure, clean, and ready for inspection.

A reptile must be at least 11 weeks old to travel on Aurelia Skyways. A cat crate must have no side longer than 61 cm, and the crate must allow safe standing, turning, and resting. If a pet does not meet these limits, travel will not be accepted at the desk.

Please arrive with your animal prepared, with water available as advised by staff, and with the carrier labeled as directed. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will check the details, confirm what is needed, and guide you through the process without delay.

For help before departure, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
